title: Corsair SF1000 (2024) SFX 80 Plus Platinum ATX Power Supply Unit $246.45 (RRP $287.52) Delivered @ Amazon UK via AU
body:
Deal: Corsair SF1000 (2024) SFX 80 Plus Platinum ATX Power Supply Unit $246.45 (RRP $287.52) Delivered @ Amazon UK via AU

[sak2901] For some reason in the title it says atx 3.1 and pcie 5.1 but in the description it says 3.0 and 5.0. I ordered one myself. Not sure which one is correct.
[xrailgun] no guarantees but chances are it's 3.1 and 5.1, the 3.0 and 5.0 variants haven't been manufactured for years
[tastycrayon] Ranked A+ on PSU tier list.
For those that wants to look it up, search “CORSAIR SF PLATINUM 2024 (ATX 3.1)” on https://psutierlist.org
[shreav] I don't think so, since it's an import. You get 30 days to return it if it's DOA. After that, you fall back on claims under ACL. But, YMMV when negotiating with Amazon about any claims - especially as you get closer to the 7 year mark.
[Oztx] Technically works with an adaptor but it's highly recommend that you get AU plug wire directly into the unit since it's modular.
[cloudie9] Just be aware these SFX1000 is notoriously short length cable. Even I am struggling setting this one up for my Jonsbo D32 case (micro ATX case). The CPU header cable isn't long enough, barely made it after trying to route it on top of the mobo, can't route behind the case.
[sak2901] I have ordered the d32 pro with this PSU. Will it cause any issue because of the tight fit?
[cloudie9] No issues other than what I mentioned with the CPU header cable, if you want hide the cable behind, it is quite impossible, not long enough.
[jeimuzu] Great price. Bought this about 1.5 yrs ago for $292.39 which worked flawlessly with NRP200. The thinner cables are nicer and don't take too much space in the case.
[FishBurgers] Just a note with this psu its gamble if you get the model with the grey or black fan, if you care about aesthetics
[panda1010101] PSUs are hidden away, and are usually unnoticeable in a case.
[DanielNg] Buying a PSU from Bequiet would be better.
